The user wants me to close the cookie banner on The Guardian's website. I need to use the browser's cookie management controls.

Let me try clicking the cookie banner controls. I'll use the `click` tool with a selector targeting the cookie banner controls.</think><|tool_call_start|>[click(selector='button[aria-label*="Accept all cookies"]'], expected_name='Accept all cookies')]<|tool_call_end|>
